Theorem
[Plancherel's Theorem] ↗ def:fourier-transform-l1 ↗ ex:bessel-potentials ↗ lem:integral-fundamental-solution-heat 1. ch4:4.3.1-thm-1\group Fourier Transform

For $u\in L^1(\R ^n)\cap L^2(\R ^n)$, \[ \hat u,\check u\in L^2(\R ^n),\qquad \| \hat u\| _2=\| \check u\| _2=\| u\| _2. \]

Proof

\sketch Apply the Gaussian regularization identity to $u*\bar u(-\cdot )$, use the Fourier convolution formula, and let the Gaussian parameter tend to zero. This proves $\| \hat u\| _2=\| u\| _2$; the inverse transform is analogous.

□
